correctness.rationale: Every integer equals a unique cube-free kernel r times a cube; complementary kernels uv² and u²v give independent complete-bipartite forbidden components, while kernel 1 forms a clique of all cubes. A maximum set chooses the larger class uniquely, or either side if equally positive: exactly floor(N^(1/3))*2^H(N) possibilities. In x=u/N^(1/3),y=v/N^(1/3), equal cube-root floor heights describe slabs in s=xy²,t=x²y with Jacobian 1/[3(st)^(2/3)]; summing area 3/[j²(j+1)²] gives pi²-9. Pair squarefree CRT local density product delta and quantified noncompact-tail estimates give H~delta(pi²-9)N^(2/3)/2. An independent exhaustive maximum-set census through N=15 and finite Euler-product computation corroborate the exact statement but not the asymptotic.
